reply.text:
That sounds serious, and I want you to get help right now. Please call your local emergency number (911 in the US) or Poison Control (1-800-222-1222 in the US) immediately, or go to the nearest emergency room. Tell them what you took, how much, and when. If you are with someone, ask them to stay with you and help you get care now.

I'm a training coach, so I can't assess this or tell you how you're doing. That needs a doctor or emergency staff. Once you're safe and have had care, I'm glad to pick the training back up whenever you're ready.
